description: A failing $ condition stops both the alternative and definition tag clauses. Their nested query never reaches the empty split delimiter, so reconstruction passes (engine §3.7, §4, §7.7).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a (A [+T])
%rule b (A [+T] [+T])
%rule c (A x)
%rule x :: $.tokens-after-first.tags(migration-fault) | T %conditions $.source-text = "q"


%rule migration-fault ε | {_} %conditions "x" ∈ $.value.split($.value)
